concerns.text: FR-001 (ingest & compute G(t)) and SC-004 (runtime feasibility) lack a task to implement the aggregation logic that merges multiple seed logs into `data/processed/trajectories_divergence.csv`. Task T016 is marked `[ ]` (unimplemented), leaving the output artifact for US1 undefined and blocking US2/US3.

FR-001 requires fetching real data from the verified CHERRL repository. Task T013 (`download_cherrl_logs.py`) is marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). Without this, the pipeline cannot ingest the required $J_{biased}$, $J_{unbiased}$, and $J_{gold}$ columns, making FR-001 impossible to satisfy.

FR-009 (exclude contaminated windows) and FR-003 (dynamic baseline) require the contaminated window mask. Tasks T025a, T025b, and T025c are all marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). Consequently, T022 (flagging logic) lacks the necessary `is_contaminated` column input to function correctly per spec.

FR-006 and FR-008 mandate halting the pipeline if correlation > 0.8. Tasks T032a and T032b are marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). This prevents the generation of the `data/processed/independence_check_status.json` artifact required by T031 (ground truth derivation), breaking the dependency chain for US3.

FR-004 (ground truth derivation) and FR-007 (sensitivity analysis) depend on T031. T031 is marked `[ ]` (unimplemented) and relies on the missing independence check artifacts. This leaves the core evaluation logic for US3 unimplemented.

FR-005 (Wilcoxon test) and SC-003 (F1 std dev check) depend on T033 (baseline generation) and T034a. T033 requires `BASELINE_SAMPLE_FRACTION` defined in T033-Pre, which is marked `[ ]`. T034a and T035 are also `[ ]`. The statistical validation layer is entirely unimplemented.
FR-007 requires a sensitivity analysis sweeping thresholds. Task T037 is marked `[ ]` and depends on T031 (unimplemented). The robustness validation across rubric types is missing.

SC-001, SC-002, and SC-003 require the final metrics report. Task T038 (generate `metrics.csv` and report) is marked `[ ]` and depends on T034a, T035, and T037 (all unimplemented). The success criteria cannot be measured.

FR-002 (rolling z-score) and FR-009 (edge cases) require `code/utils/math_utils.py`. Task T017 is marked `[ ]` (unimplemented). T015 (compute z-score) depends on T017, creating a blocking dependency for the core math logic.
FR-003 requires flagging based on $z(G(t)) > 3.0$ OR dynamic threshold. Task T022 is marked `[ ]` and depends on T025c (unimplemented). The primary detection logic is incomplete.
FR-004 requires deriving labels from $J_{gold}$ drops. Task T031 is marked `[ ]`. The ground truth generation step is missing.
FR-005 requires a stratified random baseline. Task T033 is marked `[ ]` and depends on T033-Pre (unimplemented). The baseline comparison for statistical significance is missing.
FR-007 requires sensitivity analysis. Task T037 is marked `[ ]`. The robustness check is missing.
FR-009 requires detecting contaminated windows. Tasks T025a/b/c are marked `[ ]`. The baseline suppression prevention is missing.
